# CXO Ecosystem Index

Independent structured index and reproducible intelligence layer maintained by Open Future Forum. Inclusion does not imply endorsement.

Maps: CXO roles; organizations; provider types; communities and networks; event formats; research; market maps; structured comparisons; benchmarks; executive needs; leadership topics; and industries.

Canonical resources:
- Entities: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/entities.json
- Sources: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/sources.json
- Facts: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/facts.json
- Relationships: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/relationships.json
- Knowledge graph: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/knowledge-graph.json
- Intelligence: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/intelligence.json
- Market maps: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/market-maps.json
- Comparisons: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/comparisons.json
- Benchmarks: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/benchmarks.json
- Data quality: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/data-quality.json
- Methodology: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/methodology.html
- Repository: https://github.com/OpenFutureForum/cxo-ecosystem-index

Derived statistics expose known and unknown counts, denominators, field definitions, methods, dataset version, calculation date, and source fields. Coverage is representative at dataset version ${DATASET_VERSION}.
